meta.title: "Phantom" Traffic Jams Are Real—And Scientists Know How to Stop Them

paragraphs.text: Traffic jams are a common problem of most big cities, either in developed or in developing countries, but one kind of traffic jams in particular can be especially frustrating. These are generally known as "phantom" traffic jams, in which dense traffic crawls to a halt for no apparent reason at all.

sentences.text: Traffic jams are a common problem of most big cities, either in developed or in developing countries, but one kind of traffic jams in particular can be especially frustrating.

analysis.translationLiteral: 交通堵塞是大多数大城市的一个常见问题，无论在发达国家还是在发展中国家，但是一种特别的交通堵塞可能尤其令人沮丧。

analysis.structMarkup: 【Traffic jams】 are a common problem of most big cities, (either in developed or in developing countries), 【but one kind of traffic jams in particular】 can be especially frustrating.
analysis.structureSummary: but 连接的并列句（前主系表 + either...or... 状语，后主系表）

components.part: Traffic jams
components.note: 复数名词作主语，系动词用 are；泛指各类堵车，为后面「其中一种」先留出范围

components.note: a common problem 作表语，of most big cities 限定问题归属，先摆一个谁都认的事实

components.part: either in developed or in developing countries
components.note: either ... or ... 并列两个介词短语，用「发达／发展中」把范围铺到全球，避免把现象说成局部问题

components.note: but 转折后另起分句主语；in particular 把话题从「所有堵车」收窄到「某一种」，正是全文要讲的幽灵堵车

components.note: can 表「动辄、可能」，especially 与前面的 in particular 呼应，情绪词 frustrating 与 common 形成落差

clauses: 并列关联连词连接两个平行成分，前后词性须一致。
本句主干为「but 连接的并列句（前主系表 + either...or... 状语，后主系表）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.usage: 常置于所强调成分之后。

phrases.meaning: 问题、难题（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：problem（问题，需解决）/ question（疑问，需回答）。常见搭配：a serious problem / solve a problem。

sentences.text: These are generally known as "phantom" traffic jams, in which dense traffic crawls to a halt for no apparent reason at all.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这些通常被称作「幽灵」交通堵塞，在其中密集的车流爬行到完全停下，没有任何明显的原因。

"And then you drive and drive and drive… and there isn't anything there."

paragraphs.text: The exact cause of these phantom traffic jams has long remained a mystery. But now, new research has found the cause and researchers may have come up with a solution for this frustrating traffic pattern: maintaining equal spacing between cars on the road, rather than driving so closely behind another vehicle that a collision(碰撞) is likely if that vehicle brakes suddenly.

paragraphs.text: Horn said phantom traffic jams are an emergent property of the flow of vehicles down a highway. A phantom jam begins when a car in dense traffic slows down even slightly, which causes the car behind that vehicle to slow even more—and the slowing action spreads backward through the lane of traffic like a wave, getting worse the farther it spreads. Eventually, the cars far behind are forced to stop completely or risk hitting the slower vehicles ahead—and so the traffic grinds to a halt over nothing, Horn said.

sentences.text: Horn said phantom traffic jams are an emergent property of the flow of vehicles down a highway.

analysis.translationNatural: Horn 的解释是：幽灵堵车不是某个具体事故造成的，而是车流本身「涌」出来的一种现象。
analysis.structMarkup: Horn said 【phantom traffic jams】 {are an emergent property} (of the flow of vehicles down a highway).

sentences.text: A phantom jam begins when a car in dense traffic slows down even slightly, which causes the car behind that vehicle to slow even more—and the slowing action spreads backward through the lane of traffic like a wave, getting worse the farther it spreads.

analysis.translationLiteral: 一次幽灵堵车开始于密集车流中的一辆车甚至轻微地减速时，这使得那辆车后面的车减速得更多——而这个减速动作像波一样沿着车道向后传播，传播得越远变得越糟。
analysis.translationNatural: 堵起来的起点很小：密车流里只要有一辆车稍稍一慢，后车就得刹得更狠；这股「减速」像波浪一样沿车道往回传，越往后越夸张。

sentences.text: Eventually, the cars far behind are forced to stop completely or risk hitting the slower vehicles ahead—and so the traffic grinds to a halt over nothing, Horn said.

analysis.translationNatural: 传到后面，车要么彻底刹停，要么就得冒着追尾前车的险；就这样，明明啥事没有，整条路却一点点瘫了，Horn 说。

paragraphs.text: Horn has been working on the problem of phantom traffic jams for years, and he has come up with a solution: By splitting the difference between the cars in front and the cars behind, the spacing of cars in a stream of traffic can act as a damper(抑制) on phantom traffic jams. That is, it can prevent the slow-down effect from being amplified(增强) by the cars that follow behind, he said. In essence, each driver would constantly make adjustments to keep their car roughly halfway between the car in front and the car behind.

analysis.translationLiteral: Horn 多年来一直在研究幽灵交通堵塞这一问题，而且他已经想出了一个解决办法：通过在前面的车与后面的车之间平分差值，车流中车辆的间距能够充当幽灵交通堵塞的一个抑制器(抑制)。
analysis.translationNatural: 这个问题 Horn 琢磨了好些年，办法也有了：让每辆车跟前车、后车都匀出差不多的距离，车距就能像减震器一样把幽灵堵车压下去。

paragraphs.text: Horn calls this method of vehicle spacing bilateral(双边的) control, and he said it could be achieved with relatively simple modifications to the adaptive cruise control that many new cars already have. Adaptive cruise control is a driver assistance technology that sets a maximum speed for vehicles and automatically slows the speed of the car when traffic is sensed in front of the vehicle. The technology is also known as autonomous cruise control. Such modifications, Horn said, could help fight phantom jams within a few years, maybe decades before an alternative solution, such as networked self-driving cars, becomes a reality on the roads.

paragraphs.text: New research by Horn and MIT postdoctoral associate Liang Wang, published in the journal IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, shows how bilateral control can fight the problem. sentences.text: Increasing the spacing of vehicles dampens the effect of slowdowns by cars in front of a given car, so that the slowing is not worsened until it becomes a phantom jam, the researchers said.

analysis.translationLiteral: 增大车辆间距抑制了由某一辆车前方的车造成的减速的影响，以便这一减速不被恶化到它变成一次幽灵堵车，研究者说。
analysis.translationNatural: 研究者说，车距一拉开，前车减速带来的影响就被压住，不至于一层层恶化成幽灵堵车。

components.part: Increasing the spacing of vehicles

components.part: the researchers said

phrases.meaning: 空间、空地、太空、余地、间隔；留间隔、隔开（open / green space 开放与绿地空间）（space 的现在分词/动名词形式）

because 引导从句，because of 后只能接名词；两者不能混用。
analysis.paragraphRole: 把机器人模拟背后的原理讲透：拉开车距＝掐断「减速逐级放大」，与 D 段的成因链正面对冲。

paragraphs.text: A video from the project shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control; they eventually back up in phantom jams. But when the robots are switched over to bilateral control (by flashing the lights in the room), each autonomous robot tries to keep itself halfway between the robot in front and the one behind; the phantom jams disappear as a result, Horn said.

sentences.text: A video from the project shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control; they eventually back up in phantom jams.

analysis.translationLiteral: 来自该项目的一段视频展示了一列自主机器人沿着一条轨道在没有双边控制的情况下运行；它们最终在幽灵堵车中堆挤起来。
analysis.translationNatural: 项目视频里，一队自主机器人不用双边控制、沿轨道跑着跑着，最后照样挤成一团、堵上了。
analysis.structMarkup: 【A video from the project】 _shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control_; they eventually back up in phantom jams.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 现在分词短语作宾语补足语 + 分号后并列分句

components.part: A video from the project
components.note: 单数主语，谓语用 shows；from the project 回指 J 段的机器人模拟，把证据从「搭建」推进到「拍下来了」

components.part: shows a train of autonomous robots running along a track without bilateral control
components.note: show + 宾语 + 现在分词 结构；a train of 意为「一长串」；without bilateral control 点明这是对照组

components.part: they eventually back up in phantom jams
components.note: 分号连接两个独立分句；they 回指 robots；back up 意为「（车）堵着排起来」；eventually 与 D 段 Eventually 同词，复现「无中生有」的结局

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾 + 现在分词短语作宾语补足语 + 分号后并列分句」。

phrases.meaning: 轨道、方向；追踪
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：get off track / stay on track / keep track of。
phrases.example: Keep track of your spending. 记下你的开销。

phrases.meaning: 没有、不带（后接名词或动名词）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：without doing（介词 + 动名词）/ without 不接从句（除非 without that，罕见）。常见搭配：without doing / without doubt。
phrases.example: Without making things complicated, the answer is simple. 不把事情弄复杂的话，答案很简单。

phrases.meaning: 控制、掌控
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：under control / control oneself。
phrases.example: Try to control your temper. 尽量控制住脾气。

pitfalls: 注意区分：without doing（介词 + 动名词）/ without 不接从句（除非 without that，罕见）。
注意区分：eventually（最终）/ finally（最后，强调顺序）/ in the end（最终）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 先给对照组：不开启双边控制，机器人照样堵——把「幽灵堵车会自己发生」在受控环境里重演一遍。

sentences.text: But when the robots are switched over to bilateral control (by flashing the lights in the room), each autonomous robot tries to keep itself halfway between the robot in front and the one behind; the phantom jams disappear as a result, Horn said.

analysis.translationLiteral: 但是当机器人被切换（通过闪动房间里的灯）到双边控制时，每一个自主机器人都试图把自己保持在前面的机器人与后面的那个之间的半程处；结果幽灵堵车消失了，Horn 说。
analysis.translationNatural: 可只要一切换成双边控制（靠闪一下屋里的灯发指令），每个机器人就都往前后两台的正中间靠；堵车当场就没了，Horn 说。
analysis.structMarkup: But {when the robots are switched over to bilateral control (by flashing the lights in the room)}, each autonomous robot tries to keep itself halfway between the robot in front and the one behind; the phantom jams disappear as a result, Horn said.
analysis.structureSummary: But + When 时间状语从句（被动）+ 主谓宾（分号后并列分句）

components.part: when the robots are switched over to bilateral control (by flashing the lights in the room)
components.note: When 引导；are switched over 为被动；括号里 by flashing 说明切换方式（用灯发信号），括号为卷面自带，原样保留

components.part: each autonomous robot tries to keep itself halfway between the robot in front and the one behind
components.note: each + 单数，谓语用 tries；keep itself halfway 把 E 段「保持居中」原样搬到机器人身上；the one 代替 the robot 避免重复

components.part: the phantom jams disappear as a result
components.note: 分号后给出结果；as a result 与 so that / thus 同义换词，disappear 与上句 back up 正反对照

components.part: Horn said
components.note: 句末引述，与 K1 的客观描述分开，标明「堵车消失」是 Horn 转述的观察

clauses: 状语从句「when the robots are switched over to bilateral control (by flashing th」：When 引导；are switched over 为被动；括号里 by flashing 说明切换方式（用灯发信号），括号为卷面自带，原样保留
关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。
be + 过去分词构成被动语态，主语是动作的承受者。

phrases.meaning: 因此、结果是
phrases.usage: 副词性连接成分，常置于句首并用逗号隔开。
phrases.example: It rained all day; as a result, the match was cancelled. 下了一整天雨，结果比赛取消了。

phrases.meaning: 控制、掌控

phrases.meaning: 光、光线、灯；轻的、浅色的、明亮的；点燃、照亮（light 的复数/三单形式）

被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
analysis.paragraphRole: 给出实验组并与 K1 形成前后对照：一开双边控制堵车立刻消失，用最直观的方式把方案有效性钉死。

paragraphs.text: Since starting his research on phantom traffic jams, Horn has learned that schools of fish and flocks of birds and bats use similar spacing strategies to avoid hitting each other while swimming or flying in densely packed groups. In particular, studies of millions of bats emerging at dusk from caves in Southeast Asia showed that each bat used a form of bilateral control to reduce the likelihood of collisions with other bats in the densely packed swarm(一大群), Horn said.

sentences.text: Since starting his research on phantom traffic jams, Horn has learned that schools of fish and flocks of birds and bats use similar spacing strategies to avoid hitting each other while swimming or flying in densely packed groups.

analysis.translationLiteral: 自从开始他对幽灵交通堵塞的研究以来，Horn 已经了解到鱼群以及鸟群和蝙蝠群使用相似的间距策略，以在密集拥挤的群体中游动或飞行时避免互相碰撞。
analysis.translationNatural: 研究堵车这些年，Horn 还发现：鱼群、鸟群、蝙蝠群早就用着类似的「保持间距」办法，挤成一团游、挤成一团飞，也从不撞上彼此。
analysis.structMarkup: (Since starting his research on phantom traffic jams), _Horn has learned_ {that schools of fish and flocks of birds and bats use similar spacing strategies} (to avoid hitting each other while swimming or flying in densely packed groups).
analysis.structureSummary: Since 介词状语 + 主谓 + 宾语从句（that 引导，含不定式目的状语与 while 省略式时间状语）

components.part: Since starting his research on phantom traffic jams
components.note: Since 作介词，后接动名词 starting；把「研究堵车」这段时间框成发现动物类比的由头

components.part: Horn has learned
components.note: 现在完成时，强调研究过程中逐渐得知，后接 that 宾语从句

components.part: that schools of fish and flocks of birds and bats use similar spacing strategies
components.note: schools / flocks 是鱼、鸟、蝙蝠各自的量词；similar spacing strategies 把动物本能与 bilateral control 挂上钩

components.part: to avoid hitting each other while swimming or flying in densely packed groups
components.note: 不定式作目的；avoid 后接动名词 hitting；while swimming or flying 是 while they are 的省略式；densely packed 呼应 A 段 dense traffic

clauses: 宾语从句「that schools of fish and flocks of birds and bats use similar spacing 」：schools / flocks 是鱼、鸟、蝙蝠各自的量词；similar spacing strategies 把动物本能与 bilateral control 挂上钩

句中含从属连词引导状语从句，说明原因、目的、条件或时间。

phrases.meaning: 自从（时间）；因为（原因）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：since（自从/因为）/ for（持续一段时间）/ from（起点）。常见搭配：since then / ever since。
phrases.example: Since then, many cases have been filed. 自那以后，许多案件被提起。

phrases.meaning: 研究（不可数）；调查 / 研究
phrases.usage: 注意区分：research（不可数）/ study（可数，一项研究）/ researches（罕用）。常见搭配：a body of research / research on sth。
phrases.example: A growing body of research supports this. 越来越多的研究支持这一点。

phrases.meaning: 学习、学会（learn 的过去式/过去分词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：learned（过去式/过去分词）/ learn（原形）。
phrases.example: Since starting his research on phantom traffic jams, Horn has learned that schools of fish and flocks of birds and bats use similar spacing strategies to avoid hitting each other while swimming or flying in densely packed groups. 研究堵车这些年，Horn 还发现：鱼群、鸟群、蝙蝠群早就用着类似的「保持间距」办法，挤成一团游、挤成一团飞，也从不撞上彼此。

pitfalls: although/though 引导让步从句时，主句不能再用 but（汉语习惯会说「虽然……但是」）。
because 引导从句，because of 后只能接名词；两者不能混用。

analysis.paragraphRole: 把视野从公路拉到自然界，指出鱼群鸟群本就用「间距策略」，是第 45 题「某些生物用类似策略避免密集移动中相撞」的出处。

sentences.text: In particular, studies of millions of bats emerging at dusk from caves in Southeast Asia showed that each bat used a form of bilateral control to reduce the likelihood of collisions with other bats in the densely packed swarm(一大群), Horn said.

analysis.translationLiteral: 特别地，对东南亚洞穴中黄昏时飞出的数百万只蝙蝠的研究表明，每只蝙蝠都使用了一种双边控制的形式，以降低在密集拥挤的一大群(一大群)中与其它蝙蝠碰撞的可能性，Horn 说。
analysis.translationNatural: Horn 特别提到：有研究盯着东南亚黄昏出洞的几百万只蝙蝠，发现每只都在用某种双边控制，好在那黑压压一大群里少撞上同伴。
analysis.structMarkup: (In particular), 【studies of millions of bats emerging at dusk from caves in Southeast Asia】 showed {that each bat used a form of bilateral control} (to reduce the likelihood of collisions with other bats in the densely packed swarm(一大群)), Horn said.

phrases.usage: 注意区分：particular（特定的、特别的；讲究的，形容词）/ in particular（尤其、特别，副词短语，常置于名词后）/ be particular about（对…挑剔，介词 about）/ particularly（尤其，副词）/ special（专门的、特殊的）。
